description: A Files panel that previews Markdown rendered, code with syntax colors and images, with an icon for each file type and a fuzzy filter for all files. Right-click to make, rename, move, delete, or edit remote files in a terminal editor.

settings.label: Remote terminal editor
settings.hint: Editor used to edit files on remote machines when available (falls back to the first detected editor).

options.label: Auto (micro → nvim → hx → vim → nano → vi)

settings.label: Open remote editor in
settings.hint: Where to open the terminal editor when editing a remote file.
